items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Pat knew more about me than we had anticipated. He used to listen to me with my groups in Boston way back... He tells me those were his favorite – some of his favorite records. So he was familiar with me back there.

ctx.x: I don’t think so. I don’t really know what – Pat knew more about me than we had anticipated. He used to listen to me with my groups in Boston way back. I guess he was in school then. He knew certain records I made with Kenny Burrell, and records with McCoy Tyner. He tells me those were his favorite – some of his favorite records. So he was familiar with me back there. I don’t think it was no connection at all with Chick at all.
Yeah, probably not Chick. But maybe through somebody who considers you Papa. Maybe through Jack DeJohnette.
